>
[Ogre Spider Filament](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3262)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=791" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 119

**Price** 4 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This delicate strand of spiderweb sticks to the target of a [_spider sting_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1684) spell, hampering their movement. Using this catalyst causes a creature afflicted with spider venom to become [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) instead of [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
